test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two cylinders have their heights in the ratio 1 ∶ 2 and their radii in the ratio 2 ∶ 1. What is the ratio of their volumes?
solution:
Given:-

Radius ratio = 2 : 1 and Height ratio = 1 : 2

Formula used:-

Volume of cylinder = pi r²h

Calculation:- 

Let the radius and height of cylinder-1 and cylinder-2 be r , h and R , H respectively

As given,

r : R = 2 : 1

h : H = 1 : 2

Let their volumes be V1 and V2, So

V₁= pi r²h and V₂=pi R² H

Ratio, (V₁)/(V₂)=(pi r²h)/( pi R²H)

On reducing pi from numerator and denominator then by substituting the values of radius and heights,

(V₁)/(V₂)=( 2²×1)/( 1²×2)= (2)/(1)

⇒ V1 : V2 = 2 : 1

The ratio of volumes of two cylinders is 2 : 1
